test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The action of damaging the good reputation of someone
solution:
The correct answer is **defamation.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Defamation **refers to the **act of defaming** someone, i.e., **the action of damaging someone’s good reputation.**

 
 
• **Example: ***The act of public humiliation in front of his colleagues add another level to his defamation.​*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **"Delegate"** refers to **a person** **who is sent to represent others in a meeting or conference**.

 
 
• **Example**: *The conference chairperson himself went to welcome the delegate from the United Nation.*
 
 
 
• **"Degeneration"** refers to **the process of decreasing the amount or quality of something**.
 
 
• **Example**: *Industrialization over the centuries has caused serious degeneration of forestland*.
 
 
 
• **Defection** refers to the **act of giving up allegiance to one institution or organisation while accepting the allegiance of another institution or organisation**.
 
 
• **Example:** *The defections of two of the most important party members made the party weak just before the election.*
